shortDescription: Update the firmware of a specific host in the cluster

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: check_vSAN_health
options.description: Check vSAN health while updating the firmware. C(true) checks the vSAN health while updating the firmware. C(false) does not check the vSAN health while updating the firmware.

options.name: date_time
options.description: Date and time when the job must run. This is applicable when I(run_now) is C(false). The supported format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss<offset>.

options.name: delete_job_queue
options.description: Whether to delete the job queue in iDRAC while updating firmware. C(true) deletes the job queue in iDRAC while updating firmware. C(false) does not delete the job queue in iDRAC while updating firmware.

options.name: drs_check
options.description: Allows you to check if DRS of the cluster is enabled or not. C(true) checks if Distributed Resource Scheduler (DRS) of the cluster is enabled. C(false) does not check if DRS of the cluster is enabled.

options.name: enter_maintenance_mode_options
options.description: VM migration policy during management mode. C(FULL_DATA_MIGRATION) for full data migration. C(ENSURE_ACCESSIBILITY) for ensuring accessibility. C(NO_DATA_MIGRATION) does not migrate any data.

options.name: enter_maintenance_mode_timeout
options.description: Time out value during maintenance mode in minutes.

options.name: evacuate_VMs
options.description: Allows to move the virtual machine (VM) to other host when current host is powered off. C(true) moves the VM to another host when the current host is powered off. C(false) does not move the VM to another host when the current host is powered off.

options.name: exit_maintenance_mode
options.description: Whether to exit management mode after Update. C(true) exits the management mode after Update. C(false) does not exit the management mode after Update.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of the OpenManage Enterprise Modular.

options.name: job_description
options.description: Update job description.

options.name: job_name
options.description: Update job name.

options.name: job_wait
options.description: Whether to wait till completion of the job. This is applicable when I(power_on) is C(true). C(true) waits for job completion. C(false) does not wait for job completion.

options.name: job_wait_timeout
options.description: The maximum wait time of I(job_wait) in seconds. The job is tracked only for this duration. This option is applicable when I(job_wait) is C(true).

options.name: maintenance_mode_count_check
options.description: Allows to check if any host in cluster is in management mode. C(true) checks if any host in cluster is in management mode. C(false) does not check if any host in cluster is in management mode.

options.name: port
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise HTTPS port.

options.name: reboot_options
options.description: Host reboot option for firmware update. C(FORCEREBOOT) will force reboot the server. C(SAFEREBOOT) reboots the server in safe mode. C(NEXTREBOOT) does not reboot the server.

options.name: reset_idrac
options.description: Whether to reset the iDRAC while performing firmware update. C(true) resets the iDRAC while performing firmware update. C(false) does not reset the iDRAC while performing firmware update.

options.name: run_now
options.description: Whether to run the update job now or later. C(true) runs the update job instantly. C(false) runs the update at the specified I(date_time).

options.name: targets
options.description: The target details for the firmware update operation. Either I(cluster), I(servicetag) or I(host) is required for the firmware update operation.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to check SSL certificate. - If C(true), the SSL certificates will be validated. - If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated.

options.name: vcenter_password
options.description: Password for OpenManage Enterprise Integration for VMware vCenter (OMEVV). If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(OMEVV_VCENTER_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export OMEVV_VCENTER_PASSWORD=password

options.name: vcenter_username
options.description: Username for OpenManage Enterprise Integration for VMware vCenter (OMEVV). If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(OMEVV_VCENTER_USERNAME) is used. Example: export OMEVV_VCENTER_USERNAME=username

options.name: vcenter_uuid
options.description: Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of vCenter. vCenter UUID details can be retrieved using M(dellemc.openmanage.omevv_vcenter_info) module. If UUID is not provided, then the environment variable E(OMEVV_VCENTER_UUID) is used. Example: export OMEVV_VCENTER_UUID=uuid
